shots.name: H1 newborn hand creature
shots.description: Five finger limbs and eye stalk. Asset contract: Hand_Monster_v3.glb as ordinary_model. Panorama linkage: pano_ruins. Required outputs: creature-final.png.

notes: Place the creature near ruins_platform as a hand-sized newborn, not a generic spider.
Use a low close camera that clearly reads the five finger-derived limbs and long thin eye stalk.
Keep the ruins geometry aligned to the existing styled panorama.
Hide corridor and armory geometry in this shot using shot-specific visibility only.
Target a 16:9 composition with roughly 28–38 degree FOV.
Use Hand_Monster_v3.glb as ordinary_model and produce creature-final.png.

shots.name: Sprint chase toward armory
shots.description: Three-second chase at t=0 and t=3. Asset contract: Roman Joseph Amputated.glb as saved_rig_character with Roman Joseph Amputated.fsrig; Hand_Monster_v3.glb as ordinary_model. Panorama linkage: none. Required outputs: chase-start.png, chase-mid.png, chase-end.png, chase-motion.mp4.

notes: Create a 3.0-second chase with keyframes at t=0 and t=3; a t=1.5 keyframe is encouraged but not mandatory.
Joseph begins near corridor_background and runs toward corridor_foreground/armory direction on two legs.
The creature starts about 1–1.5 meters behind and remains visibly in pursuit.
Joseph must read as J2 amputated: right stump, no sword prosthetic, right eyepatch, two legs.
Use a side-on or three-quarter tracking camera that keeps both subjects readable.
Do not link a styled panorama because none is calibrated for the corridor.
Hide ruins and armory geometry using shot-specific visibility only.
Use Roman Joseph Amputated.glb as saved_rig_character with Roman Joseph Amputated.fsrig; Hand_Monster_v3.glb as ordinary_model.
Produce chase-start.png, chase-mid.png, chase-end.png, chase-motion.mp4.

shots.name: J3 battle-ready stance
shots.description: Shield and wrist blade. Asset contract: Roman Joseph Final.glb as saved_rig_character with Roman Joseph Final.fsrig. Panorama linkage: pano_armory. Required outputs: fighter-final.png.

notes: Place Joseph at armory_center in a readable full-body battle-ready stance.
Continuity: right eyepatch, right wrist-mounted short sword/prosthetic, shield on left arm, two legs.
Use built-in character geometry for the shield/blade when available; otherwise create simple primitives without modifying the base set.
Keep the armory geometry aligned to the existing styled panorama.
Hide ruins and corridor geometry using shot-specific visibility only.
Target a 16:9 composition with roughly 28–38 degree FOV.
Use Roman Joseph Final.glb as saved_rig_character with Roman Joseph Final.fsrig and produce fighter-final.png.
